title: isotrema durior
intro: Isotrema durior, commonly known as the Yellow Stems or Yellow Banded, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Isotrema durior include alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as inducing a sedative effect and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of the plant also include its potential to treat various health conditions, including fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues.
